title: A signal recognition particle-related joint model of LASSO regression, SVM-RFE and artificial neural network for the diagnosis of systemic sclerosis-associated pulmonary hypertension.
summary: A joint LASSO/SVM/ANN model identifies serum/gene features for systemic-sclerosis pulmonary hypertension, validated in training/test cohorts with seven candidate diagnostic genes and ROC performance. This is a specific clinical biomarker result; performance remains cohort-based rather than prospective.
